channel.title: Live: UCI Track World Championships
channel.desc: Clare Balding presents live coverage from day 4 of the Track Cycling World Championships in Shanghai, with British medal hopes in the women's madison and a world record expected in the emerging women's 1km time trial event. Analysis comes from Laura Kenny. Plus a chance to catch up on the best of the action from the first three days of competition.
